content:
Last week, Apple launched a new round of beta testing for its 27.2 series software, and just five days later, today it released beta 2 for iPadOS 27.2 and several other systems.

iPadOS 27.2 beta 2 update released, with tvOS 27.2, visionOS 27.2 and more updated simultaneously

Apple has been very busy with software releases this week.

Last Monday, Apple officially rolled out major updates including iOS 27, iPadOS 27, and macOS Golden Gate to the public. A few days later, the 27.2 series developer beta 1 followed.

Skipping 27.1 is indeed surprising, but according to reports, this update will only be available for iPhone Duo.

So Apple has gone straight from 27.2 and made it available for beta testers. The most noteworthy new features in iPadOS 27.2 and other systems include:

  • Apple TV personal profile feature arrives on iPhone and iPad
  • Completely redesigned and significantly upgraded Health app
  • Siri AI expanded to support more languages
  • iPadOS adds a Siri feature that was previously exclusive to Mac

Today, beta 2 has officially been pushed to iPadOS 27.2, watchOS 27.2, tvOS 27.2 and several other systems.

It's only been five days since beta 1 was released, so today's update should not see major changes, mainly focusing on bug fixes and performance improvements, with perhaps a few minor new features added.

Have you installed iPadOS 27.2 or the beta 2 of any other systems? If you've spotted anything new, feel free to share it with us in the comments section.

Essential accessories for work: iPad, Apple Watch, Apple TV recommendations

  • AirPods Pro 3 (now only $199, originally $249)
  • Portable Apple Watch USB-C charger
  • 100W USB-C fast charging power adapter
  • Anti-slip silicone protective case for Siri Remote, AirTag compatible
  • HomeKit smart plug (four-pack set)
